'''Guy Charles Lloyd-Jones''' [[Fellow of the Royal Society|FRS]]<ref>{{ cite web | url = http://royalsociety.org/people/guy-lloyd-jones/ | title = Professor Guy Lloyd-Jones FRS | work = The Royal Society | accessdate=2013-05-05 }}</ref> [[Fellow of the Royal Society of Edinburgh|FRSE]] (born 17 May 1966) is a British chemist. He is the Forbes Professor of Organic Chemistry at the [[University of Edinburgh]] in the United Kingdom. His research is largely concerned with the determination of [[organometallic]] [[reaction mechanism]]s, especially those of [[palladium-catalyzed coupling reactions]] such as [[Suzuki reaction|Suzuki-Miyaura coupling]].<ref>{{cite web | url = http://www.lloyd-jones.chem.ed.ac.uk/research.shtml | title = Research | work = Lloyd-Jones research group website | accessdate = 2013-10-20 | archive-url = https://archive.today/20131020200502/http://www.lloyd-jones.chem.ed.ac.uk/research.shtml | archive-date = 20 October 2013 | url-status = dead }}</ref><ref>{{Cite journal

==Biography==
Lloyd-Jones received a Bachelor of Science degree from [[Huddersfield Polytechnic]] in 1989, and a [[Doctor of Philosophy|DPhil]] from the [[University of Oxford]] in 1992.<ref name="lloydphd">{{cite thesis |degree=PhD |first=Guy Charles|last=Lloyd-Jones |title=Catalytic hydrometallation |publisher=University of Oxford |year=1992 |url=http://solo.bodleian.ox.ac.uk/primo_library/libweb/action/dlDisplay.do?docId=oxfaleph015968367|authorlink=Guy Lloyd-Jones}}</ref> He was a [[Royal Society]] Western European postdoctoral research fellow at [[Basel University]] from 1993 to 1995 with Professor [[Andreas Pfaltz]]. He joined the [[University of Bristol]] as a lecturer in 1996, before being promoted to [[Reader (academic rank)|reader]] in 2000, professor in 2003 and Head of Organic and Biological Chemistry in 2012.<ref>{{ cite web | url = http://www.bristol.ac.uk/chemistry/people/guy-c-lloyd-jones/ | title =  Professor Guy Lloyd-Jones | work = University of Bristol, School of Chemistry website | accessdate=2012-06-01 }}</ref><ref name="GCLJwebbio">{{cite web | url = http://www.lloyd-jones.chem.ed.ac.uk/lloyd-jones.shtml | title = Professor Guy Lloyd–Jones | work = Lloyd-Jones research group website | accessdate = 2013-10-20 | archive-url = https://archive.today/20131020200504/http://www.lloyd-jones.chem.ed.ac.uk/lloyd-jones.shtml | archive-date = 20 October 2013 | url-status = dead }}</ref> In 2013, he moved to the University of Edinburgh to take up the Forbes Chair of Organic Chemistry.<ref name="GCLJwebbio" />

Lloyd-Jones's work has been recognised by awards such as the [[Royal Society of Chemistry|RSC]]'s Hickinbottom Fellowship (2000),<ref>{{ cite web | url = http://www.rsc.org/ScienceAndTechnology/Awards/HickinbottomAward/PreviousWinners.asp | title = RSC Hickinbottom Award Previous Winners | publisher = Royal Society of Chemistry | accessdate=2012-06-01 }}</ref> the [[GDCh|German Chemical Society's]] Liebig Lectureship (2003),<ref>{{ cite web | url = https://www.gdch.de/netzwerk-strukturen/fachstrukturen/liebig-vereinigung-fuer-organische-chemie/liebig-lectureship.html | publisher = GDCh | title = Liebig-Lectureship | accessdate=2012-06-01 }}</ref> the RSC [[Corday–Morgan Medal]] (2003),<ref>{{ cite web | url = http://www.rsc.org/ScienceAndTechnology/Awards/CordayMorganPrizes/PreviousWinners.asp | title = RSC Corday–Morgan Prize Previous Winners | publisher = Royal Society of Chemistry | accessdate=2012-06-01 }}</ref> the RSC Organic Reaction Mechanisms Prize (2007), the GSK/AZ/Pfizer/Syngenta UK Prize for Process Chemistry Research (2010), a [[Royal Society Wolfson Research Merit Award]] (2008–2013) and the RSC Physical Organic Chemistry Medal and Ingold Lectureship (2013). Professor Lloyd-Jones was elected a Fellow of the [[Royal Society]] in 2013<ref>{{ cite web | url = http://royalsociety.org/news/2013/new-Fellows-2013/ | title = Royal Society elects new Fellows for 2013 | work = The Royal Society | accessdate=2013-05-04 }}</ref> and a Fellow of the [[Royal Society of Edinburgh]] in 2015.<ref>{{Cite news|url=https://www.rse.org.uk/fellow/guy-lloyd-jones/|title=Professor Guy Charles Lloyd-Jones FRS, FRSC FRSE - The Royal Society of Edinburgh|work=The Royal Society of Edinburgh|access-date=2018-02-12|language=en-GB}}</ref>
